$comment: Names, usage notes and type styles only. Colour, radius and shadow VALUES are generated from the app stylesheet by .design-sync/build.mjs; the themes list is set there too.

tokens.name: color-bg-primary
tokens.usage: Panels and data surfaces: `.card`, `.kpi-card`, `.table-wrapper`, the idle `.bulk-bar`, the global-search field and its dropdown, and the `.btn-secondary` fill. Carries `color-text-primary` and `color-text-secondary`.

tokens.name: color-bg-secondary
tokens.usage: The page ground: `body`, `.page-header-sticky`, `.capacity-stat-card`, and the hover row in dropdown menus and global search. Carries `color-text-primary`.

tokens.name: color-bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Chrome that frames content: `.sidebar`, `thead th`, `.modal-header`, `.slideover-header` and `.slideover-footer`, and inline `code`. Carries `color-text-secondary` and `color-text-tertiary`.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: One step above `color-bg-primary`, for things that sit on top of a panel: `.btn-dropdown-menu`, `.search-select-dropdown`, `.table-tab.active`, `.mac-tooltip`, the active `.bulk-bar`, and `.btn-secondary:hover`. Carries `color-text-primary`.

tokens.name: color-bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Popovers and row hover on the dashboard: `.widget-config-popover`, `.widget-export-menu`, `.widget-library-card`, `.dash-alert-row:hover`, `.recent-item-link:hover`, and the site-map Leaflet popups.

tokens.name: color-hover-tint
tokens.usage: Pointer feedback on bare controls — dashboard grips, widget actions, `.widget-picker-group:hover`. A white wash in the dark themes and a black one in daylight; it tints whatever is underneath and is never a fill of its own.

tokens.name: color-fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Static faint fills that are not hover feedback: `.dep-tree-block`, `.widget-export-count`, `.widget-picker-group-count`.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: The default 1px edge — `.sidebar`, `.page-header-sticky`, `.card`, form controls, `.capacity-stat-card`, the `.spinner` track. The one border token to reach for unless you are separating rows inside a surface.

tokens.name: color-border-light
tokens.usage: The lighter separator inside a surface: `tbody td` row rules, `.slideover-pagination`, `.gs-hint-foot`, `.mac-tooltip-header`.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `color-bg-secondary`, `color-bg-primary` and `color-surface`; also the hover colour of the muted sidebar links.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, meta text, `.card-title` and inline `code` on `color-bg-primary` and `color-bg-tertiary`; the resting colour of `.sidebar-nav a`.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: The faintest text — `.hint`, `.kpi-label`, `.empty-state`, group labels, `thead` captions and `.sidebar-brand` — on `color-bg-primary` and `color-bg-tertiary`. Never body copy. Contrast warning: this pairing is below 4.5:1 on `color-bg-primary` in all four themes (2.9:1 in `morning`) and on `color-bg-tertiary` in `morning`, `noon` and `nightfall`. Carried from the source unchanged — don't use it for anything a reader must read.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Links, the active sidebar item, the `.btn-primary` fill, `:focus-visible` outlines, and the informational/watch tints. The colour the product is recognised by. Contrast warning: as link text it falls to 2.7:1 on `color-bg-secondary` in `morning` and 3.0:1 on `color-bg-primary`. Carried from the source unchanged.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: The same value as `color-accent`; the name the sheet uses for `.spinner`, `.table-tab-dot`, `.row-menu-trigger` and several focus outlines. Keep the two in step — changing one alone splits the accent.

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: The `.btn-primary:hover` fill and border. Nothing else uses it.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Up, available, active: `.btn-success`, `.badge-active`, `.badge-available`, `.badge-monitored`, `.dot-ok`, `.toast-success`, a completed `.stepper-step`. Contrast warning: 4.5:1 on `color-bg-primary` in `morning`, just under the floor. Carried from the source unchanged.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Degraded or expiring: `.btn-warning`, `.badge-expired`, `.badge-v6`, `.badge-level-warning`, the amber capacity pills and `.ip-dot-expired`. Contrast warning: 2.9:1 on `color-bg-primary` in `morning` and 3.5:1 in `noon`. It reads as a tinted fill, not as text, in the daylight themes. Carried from the source unchanged.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and failures: `.btn-danger`, `.badge-conflict`, `.nav-conflict-dot`, the red capacity pills, and the query abort controls. Contrast warning: 4.4:1 on `color-bg-primary` in `nightfall`, just under the floor. Carried from the source unchanged.

tokens.name: color-danger-hover
tokens.usage: Declared for the hover state of destructive controls. No rule in the carried `bundle.css` reads it — `.btn-danger:hover` darkens by its own literal — so treat it as the value to use if you add one.

tokens.name: color-deprecated
tokens.usage: Grey retired states: `.badge-deprecated`, `.badge-released`, `.badge-decommissioned`, `.badge-unmonitored`, `.ip-dot-released`, `.dep-tree-pip-unmon`. Contrast warning: below 4.5:1 on `color-bg-primary` in every theme (3.3:1 in `morning`). It is a muted state colour by intent; pair it with a badge label, never use it alone. Carried from the source unchanged.

tokens.name: color-sev-serious
tokens.usage: The orange severity step between warning and danger: `.sev-select.sev-serious`, the maintenance calendar's ad-hoc chips, and `.widget-pill-orange` on nightfall (on the daylight themes the widget pill takes nightfall's literal `#ff8a00` as a ringed pill, not this token). Defined only for the dark base and the daylight base; the other themes inherit.

tokens.name: color-sev-notice
tokens.usage: The neutral severity step below serious: `.widget-pill-neutral` and `.sev-select.sev-notice`. Defined only for the dark base and the daylight base; the other themes inherit.

tokens.name: color-brand-red
tokens.usage: The brand mark red: strokes the accent shape of the active sidebar icon. A brand colour, not a status colour — never use it to mean down or danger.

tokens.name: color-sev-informational
tokens.usage: Informational severity: badges, pills and severity selects. The dark themes take the theme accent; the daylight block pins a distinct blue so it never reads as a fourth orange.

tokens.name: color-sev-warning
tokens.usage: Warning severity: badges, pills and severity selects. Resolves to color-warning in the dark themes and a darker gold in daylight, so the word stays readable.

tokens.name: color-sev-critical
tokens.usage: Critical severity: badges, pills and severity selects. Resolves to color-danger in the dark themes and a deeper red in daylight.

styles.name: body-copy
styles.usage: `body`. `color-text-primary` on `color-bg-secondary`. The application root is 14px, so every size in this group is the sheet's rem value converted at 14px.

styles.name: card-heading
styles.usage: `.card-title`, in `color-text-secondary`. CSS applies the uppercase — type the label in sentence case.

styles.name: metric-value
styles.usage: `.kpi-value`. Always mono — a metric is an identifier, not prose.

styles.name: pill-label
styles.usage: `.badge`. Capitalized by CSS; one or two words.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: `.mono` and `td.mono` — IPs, MACs, serials and IDs in a table cell or detail row.

styles.name: empty-message
styles.usage: `.empty-state`, in `color-text-tertiary`, centred in a table body or a card.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The desktop `.sidebar` width. `.layout` reserves it; never restate it per page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls: `.btn-icon`, `.bulk-bar`, inline `code`, `.search-select-input`, the dashboard list rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The desktop default: `.btn`, `.kpi-card`, `.sidebar-nav a`, `textarea`, dropdown menus, `.toast`, the top corners of `.table-tab`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels: `.card`, `.table-wrapper`, `.modal`, `.settings-card`, `.empty-state-card`.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Retired for cards: a 4px blur is invisible under a wide box on the daylight themes. Kept only because older markup names it; use shadow-card on a card.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Surfaces that float OVER the page: menus, dropdowns, popovers, modals, toasts. Carries no rim.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Big opaque surfaces that rest ON the page: every card, dashboard widget, table wrapper, map and graph canvas, and .chart-box. Two drop layers plus a 1px inset top rim, which is what reads as raised on the dark themes.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Small chrome that sits on a surface: buttons, inputs, tabs. A tight drop plus the same inset rim. Buttons on a page card take map-btn-shadow instead.

tokens.name: map-btn-shadow
tokens.usage: Buttons on a map canvas (Device Map, Application Map) and on a page card (.card, .folder-card, .settings-card, .dashboard-widget...): a short 2px drop with a 4px blur plus a 1px contact edge, no rim. Modals and slide-overs keep shadow-control.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: The tightest lift, for badges and widget pills; anything blurrier reads as a smudge at 0.72rem.
